title: The tabs on the lids break off.
text: The tabs on the lids break off.. I love these bowls. I love they can go from the freezer to the microwave, but I do not like the lids. This quality of the lids or tops is poor. I have had a few break off when trying to open them. If the lids or tops were better these would be great, but since they broke I have to give a rating of 2 out of 5.
